description.value: Farina a Legna is a casual, intimate Italian pizzeria in North Vancouver's Lower Lonsdale neighbourhood, built around a wood-fired oven that anchors the entire menu. Food is served family-style across antipasti, housemade pasta, and Neapolitan-style pizza, with seasonal ingredients sourced from local farmers alongside specialty imports from Italy. Cyclists arriving in Lower Lonsdale after riding the North Shore routes will find a welcoming sit-down spot with a broad menu that accommodates most dietary needs.
